IS: 9410 (Part I) -1980 




Indian Standard ( Reaffirmed 1997 ) 

SPECIFICATION FOR SILVER CLIP SET 

PARTI FORCEPS, CLIP CUTTING AND FORMING 



1. Scope— Dimensional and other requirements for clip cutting and forming forceps used in 
neurosurgery. 

2 9 Shape and Dimensions — As shown in Fig. 1. 



M4*5 SCREW 




All dimensions in millimetres. 
FiG, 1 FORCEPS, CLIP CUTTING AND FORMING 

ri A deviation of ± 2'5 percent shall be allowed on all dimensions. 

2.2 A deviation of ± 2° shall be allowed for angular dimensions. 

3 Material — Arms of the forceps shall be made from stainless steel conforming to Designation 
40Cr13 of IS : 6603 - 1972 'Specification for stainless steel bars and flats 1 . The spring shall be made 
from stainless steel strips conforming to Designation 30Cr13 of IS : 691 1 - 1972 'Specification for 
stainless steel plate, sheet and strip'.

IS : 9410 ( Parti)- 1980 

4. Workmanship and Finish 

4.1 The forceps shall be free from scale, pits, burrs, cracks, tool marks and other surface defects. 

4.2 All edges shall be smoothly rounded-off, except the cutting edge of the working end, which 
shall be as shown in Fig. 1. 

4.3 The joint shall be recessed screw joint type in accordance with 6 of IS : 3642 - 1966 'General 
requirements for surgical instruments', 

4.4 The forceps shall operate smoothly without any play or tightness. The spring action shall be 
smooth and shall not be unduly hard or slack. The cutting and forming action shall be neat and 
clean. 

4.5 The forceps shall be finished bright and passivated. The holding surface of the arms of the 
forceps shall have a matt finish. 

5. Heat-Treatment — The arms of the forceps shall be uniformly hardened and tempered to give a 
hardness of 540 to 600 HV. The working end of the arms shall be additionally heat-treated to give 
a hardness of 625 to 650 HV. The spring shall be heat-treated to give a hardness of 500 to 550 HV. 

6. Tests 

6.1 The forceps shall be made to cut and form clips from non-hardened mild steel wire of 0*8 mm 
dia for at least 100 times. The clips shall be formed neatly without any tearing or dragging. At 
the end of the test, the working edges of the forceps shall not be damaged. 

6.2 Corrosion Resistance ~- The forceps shall be tested in accordance with IS : 7531 - 1975 'Method 
for boiling and autoclaving test for corrosion resistance of stainless steel instruments'. There shall 
be no sign of corrosion and the forceps shall operate properly and smoothly after the test. 

7 S Marking — The forceps shall be marked legibly and indelibly, with manufacturer's name, initials 
or recognized trade-mark and the word 'Stainless', 

7.1 ISI Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 

8. Packing — The forceps shall be wrapped in moisture proof paper and then packed individually 
in cardboard carton. Alternatively packing may be done as agreed to between the purchaser and 
the supplier.
